learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to spot fun shapes, find things with straight and curved edges, and see what rolls or slides!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look around! The sun is round, your book is a rectangle, and a sandwich is a triangle. Shapes are everywhere.
A ball is round and it ROLLS. A heavy box is flat and it SLIDES. Try rolling and sliding your toys on the floor!
Run your finger on a table. The long part is the edge, and the pointy part is the corner. A ball has no corners!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Rolling Race
fun_activity.instructions: Take a ball, a block, and an eraser. Push them on the floor or a slope to see which one rolls and which one slides!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned to spot different shapes around us.
⭐ We found out that round things roll and flat things slide.
⭐ We know how to find corners and edges on things.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to count big numbers, make bundles of ten, and see which numbers come next!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Instead of counting one by one, we can tie ten sticks together to make a bundle! It makes counting big numbers so easy.
If we have one bundle of ten and three extra sticks, it makes 13! The bundle is 'Tens' and the extra sticks are 'Ones'.
Numbers love to stand in a line. After 5 comes 6, and after 6 comes 7. We can count forwards and backwards easily!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Matchstick Bundles
fun_activity.instructions: Take some matchsticks or crayons. Tie them in bundles of ten using a rubber band and count how many you have in total!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned to count bigger numbers with ease.
⭐ We made bundles of ten to count faster.
⭐ We practiced what number comes next and what comes before.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about long and short shadows, times of the day, and measure things with our hands and feet!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When you stand in the sun, a dark shape follows you! That is your shadow. Sometimes it is very long, and sometimes it is short.
We wake up in the Morning, play in the Evening, and sleep at Night. Everything happens at the right time!
We can measure a table with our handspans and a room with our footsteps. Try measuring your bed today!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Handspan Measurement
fun_activity.instructions: Use your handspan (the distance from your thumb to your little finger) to measure how long your favorite book or toy car is!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned how our shadow changes size in the sun.
⭐ We know the difference between morning, afternoon, and night.
⭐ We used our hands and feet to measure long and short things.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to draw standing, sleeping, and slanting lines, and use them to make cool shapes and letters!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Some lines stand straight up like a tall tree. Some lines sleep flat like a bed. They are called straight lines!
A slide in the park is a slanting line. A big smiling face has a happy curved line!
Look at the letter 'A'. It has two slanting lines and one sleeping line in the middle. We can draw anything with lines!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Line Art Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Look at the door in your room. Can you find the standing lines and sleeping lines? Trace them in the air with your finger!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned to spot standing, sleeping, and slanting lines.
⭐ We saw how straight and curved lines look different.
⭐ We used lines to make letters and shapes.

learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to make beautiful patterns, arrange colors, and decorate our homes for fun festivals!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A pattern is when things repeat. Like a red flower, then a yellow flower, then a red flower again!
During festivals, we make colorful Rangolis and hang leafy garlands. We use shapes and colors in a pattern to make them look pretty.
If you see a circle, then a square, then a circle... what comes next? A square! Guessing the next shape is a very fun game.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Bindi Pattern Maker
fun_activity.instructions: Take colorful bindis or stones. Make a beautiful line on a paper: red, green, red, green... and show your pattern to your family!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned how patterns are made by repeating things.
⭐ We learned how to decorate using colorful shapes and patterns.
⭐ We practiced guessing what shape or color comes next.
